notices.name: auth_rls_initplan
notices.title: Auth RLS Initialization Plan
notices.description: Detects if calls to \`current_setting()\` and \`auth.<function>()\` in RLS policies are being unnecessarily re-evaluated for each row

notices.name: no_primary_key
notices.title: No Primary Key
notices.description: Detects if a table does not have a primary key. Tables without a primary key can be inefficient to interact with at scale.

notices.name: unused_index
notices.title: Unused Index
notices.description: Detects if an index has never been used and may be a candidate for removal.

notices.name: multiple_permissive_policies
notices.title: Multiple Permissive Policies
notices.description: Detects if multiple permissive row level security policies are present on a table for the same \`role\` and \`action\` (e.g. insert). Multiple permissive policies are suboptimal for performance as each policy must be executed for every relevant query.
